title: Thyristor 12-Pulse Generator
text: Generate thyristor 12-pulse waveform in single-pulsing mode, 2 inputs, 2 outputs; {Pulse ordering}, {Delta connection} sets the delta sinusoidal phase variance model, {Pulse width (rad)} sets the pulse width 5*pi/6 and {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the block sample time 1e-5. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Pulse ordering
params.values: Pulse ordering strategy Sequential device order (default) | Natural order of commutation

params.name: Delta connection
params.values: Delta sinusoidal phase variance model Leading (Delta11) (default) | Lagging (Delta1)

params.name: Pulse width (rad)
params.values: Pulse width 5*pi/6 rad (default) | positive scalar in range [0, pi]
